summary: Inter & Co, Inc. filed a Form 6-K with its 2Q26 earnings release and presentation. The report covers quarterly results: net income, client growth, revenue growth of 31.7% YoY, ROE of 16%, loan portfolio growth of 29% YoY, and R$100 billion in total assets. This is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation transaction. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring activity is mentioned. The filing is purely operational and financial reporting.
